reviews.title: New layout is a major step backwards
reviews.text:
I use Google Translate regularly and the latest update has made the app significantly less convenient to use.

The new home screen now has large “Practice” and “Live translation” cards placed directly between the language selection and the main translation box. I primarily use the app for quick text translations, so these cards take up valuable screen space for features I don’t need and make the interface unnecessarily cluttered.

Worse, their positioning makes them very easy to tap accidentally. I now regularly open voice/live translation or the Spanish learning feature when I’m simply trying to type a translation. There also appears to be no option to hide or disable these cards.

Please give users the ability to customise the home screen or hide these promotional/feature cards. The previous layout was much cleaner, quicker and easier to use. Adding new features is fine, but they shouldn’t make the app’s core translation function less accessible.

reviews.title: Please bring back the old layout
reviews.text:
Google Translate has been one of my go-to apps for years, but the latest iPhone redesign is a major downgrade. Moving the text-entry box to the bottom makes basic translation awkward and less efficient, especially when entering longer text or switching languages. The previous layout was clearer, faster, and far more practical.

This feels like a needless redesign that prioritizes appearance over usability. Please move the text box back to the top, or at minimum, add a setting that lets users choose the classic layout. Stop forcing longtime users to accept a worse interface when the old one worked perfectly well.

reviews.title: Pop up sidebar, blinking as text added
reviews.text:
Recently appeared and is very distracting and unnecessary. This is spoiling an otherwise very good App.
I have not mentioned advertising. The problem is that when I start typing, immediately a sidebar appears, squeezing the two pane translation section to the left. This half screen sidebar on the right blinks annoyingly with every letter typed. It is not a pop up advert, it is a program change where someone thought that the sidebar would be useful; it isn't, it's really irritating. Previously, the language entered would be translated beneath, with the option to tap the arrow between the two panes to switch the translation back and forth.
e.g. top pane English, bottom pane french - perfect. Arrow to swap panes, french english to english french. Simplicity! Adding a pop up side panel spoils the process completely; whoever though that was a good idea!
Have a go, you'll see what I mean.
